MaiCord 0.5.x installs this update from Settings > Updates. If you're still on 0.4.0, follow the one-time manual steps in the 0.5.0 release notes.

### Highlights

- **Faster Gateway.**
  - Bursts of messages are processed about 40% faster, and READY about 30% faster.
- **Steadier connections.**
  - TLS reconnects resume the previous session, so the handshake takes 5.2 ms instead of 10.8 ms.
  - Idle connections reconnect cleanly instead of failing the first request after a quiet spell.
- **Lighter on memory and disk.**
  - Chat state uses less memory, and the executable shrinks from 6.98 to 6.91 MB.
- **Faster image thumbnails.**
  - WebP thumbnails decode 43% faster, and JPEG thumbnails up to 17% faster.
- **Closer to the official client.**
  - Slowmode is tracked per channel.
  - Reconnect backoff follows the official client.
  - Pinned messages load in pages of 25.
  - Bulk bans stop at the API's limit of 200 users.
- **Server tag icons no longer draw over the channel header.**

### Fixes

- Fix a crash on Lottie outlines with no valid bounds
- Fix the status line failing text layout

### Performance

- Vectorise the CPU thumbnail decoders and share the deflate tables
- Prune SDK declarations, speed up memmove and compile media decoders for size
- Speed up ETF and JSON string handling and cut chat model revalidation
- Speed up JSON scanning and match the client on settings timing and login_source

### Other

- Clip message header tags and chips to the message viewport
- Share one Schannel credential across connections so reconnects resume the TLS session
- Remove code only tests read and link more tests into shared bundles
- Keep rich message items in recycled side blocks and hash channel batch duplicates
- Shrink TLS and Gateway buffers and answer READY from its structural index
- Retry opt-in GETs, send the User-Agent on downloads and release retired TLS buffers
- Index the Gateway's JSON while transcoding ETF and follow visible guild users
- Decode gateway dispatches from the frame index and match the client on slowmode and acks
- Page pins at 25, close idle REST connections early and cap bulk bans at 200
- Track slowmode per channel and decode message pages from their structural index
- Animate the showcase hero
- Prune redundant comments added since 0.5.0
- Remake the website showcase
- Require AES-NI and drop the GCM64 fallback

MaiCord 0.5.x installs this update from Settings > Updates. If you're still on 0.4.0, follow the one-time manual steps in the 0.5.0 release notes.

### Highlights

- **Lighter voice calls.**
  - Voice decoding is 11–25% faster, and encoding 4–17% faster, with identical audio.
  - End-to-end encrypted (DAVE) audio frames decrypt about 3× faster and encrypt about 2× faster, using the processor's AES instructions when available.
  - Joining and updating encrypted calls takes less work: group changes are about 20% faster.
- **Slash command picker fixes.**
  - The category rail follows your theme, including gradient backgrounds.
  - Apps without a bot avatar, such as Wordle, show their app icon in the picker and in the command bar.

### Performance

- Speed up Opus and the voice audio path

### Other

- Slim DAVE and MLS and run DAVE AES-GCM with AES-NI
- Theme the command picker rail and show app pictures like the client
- Copy the bundled fonts once instead of racing per-target copies

MaiCord 0.5.0 installs this update from Settings > Updates. If you're still on 0.4.0, follow the one-time manual steps in the 0.5.0 release notes.

### Highlights

- **Slash commands like Discord's.** The `/` picker has Discord's rail, sections, search results and Frequently Used list, and you can navigate it with the keyboard. Options are chips with checks and Tab movement. Discord's built-in commands work: `/gif` and `/sticker` show their results above the composer, and `/shrug`, `/tableflip`, `/me`, `/spoiler`, `/nick`, `/thread`, `/msg`, `/leave`, `/kick`, `/ban` and `/timeout` are also available.
- **Apps and bots.**
  - Buttons show their emoji, and Components V2 layouts follow Discord's.
  - The "used /command" header opens the command's options.
  - Bot profiles show the bot's real status, a formatted bio and its Commands.
- **Links and expressions.**
  - Links to attachments, messages, channels and threads appear as chips.
  - Emoji and stickers have tooltips and popouts.
  - Stickers appear at Discord's size.
- **Faster and leaner.**
  - A new MP3 decoder for sounds and audio messages, about 1.5× faster than the previous one.
  - Text shaping 8–20% faster.
  - Scrolling and channel switching about 10% faster.
  - Fewer GPU draw calls.
  - A slightly smaller `MaiCord.exe`.

### Features

- Add the client's built-in slash commands and its picker keyboard rules
- Show emoji and sticker tooltips and popouts in messages

### Fixes

- Fix DM profile panel text timing, bio clamp, footer and Commands

### Other

- Slim the renderer and UI framework
- Polish slash commands like the official client
- Update the README for the single executable and current features
- Slim the text engine
- Decode MP3 frames in place and drop checks that cannot fail
- Match the official client's components, headers, links, bot profiles and slash commands
- Replace minimp3 with MaiCord's own MP3 decoder
- Draw message stickers and accessories with the official client metrics
- Match Discord desktop 1.0.9266 client properties

### Updating from 0.4.0

MaiCord 0.4.0 and the 0.4.1 preview builds can't install 0.5.0 from Settings > Updates. Update once by hand; later releases install from Settings again.

1. Quit MaiCord, including from the tray.
2. Download `MaiCord-0.5.0-windows-x64.zip` below and copy the `MaiCord.exe` inside it over the `MaiCord.exe` you start MaiCord with, in the folder you extracted MaiCord to. If MaiCord installed updates for you before, replace that same file, not a copy in `%LOCALAPPDATA%\MaiCord\updates\generations`.
3. Start MaiCord. Your accounts, settings, themes, keybinds, drafts and plugins carry over.

After 0.5.0 has started once, you can delete what the old updater left behind. Nothing uses these any more, so this is optional:

- the folder `%LOCALAPPDATA%\MaiCord\updates\generations`
- the file `%LOCALAPPDATA%\MaiCord\updates\enrollment.bin`
- `MaiCordAccount.dll` next to `MaiCord.exe`

Keep everything else in `%LOCALAPPDATA%\MaiCord`: it holds your sign-in and settings.

### Highlights

- **Updates install when you choose.** MaiCord downloads an update in the background and installs it only when you select **Restart to update** in Settings > Updates or on the title bar badge. Closing MaiCord keeps the version you're running.
- **One smaller file.** MaiCord is a single 6.9 MB `MaiCord.exe`, down from 8.1 MB for `MaiCord.exe` and `MaiCordAccount.dll` in 0.4.0.
- **Faster start.** MaiCord shows your servers, channels and draft from last time as soon as it opens, while it connects.

### Performance

- Build without unwind tables

- Drop unused protocol decode modes and simplify parsers
- Remove dead app state and share file persistence helpers

- Share Gateway client, voice log and DAVE failure helpers
- Shrink application modules with shared helpers and literal appends

- Share text shaping frontends and pass shaping views by reference

- Keep updating installations whose journal 0.4.x wrote

…

- **AV1 and H.265 Go Live and camera streams**, decoded on the GPU. MaiCord offers AV1, then H.265, then H.264, but only the codecs your GPU decodes in hardware.
- **Zero-copy live video**: decoded frames go straight from the decoder to the screen.
- **Faster text engine**: Latin shaping is about 40% faster, Indic and Arabic 8–17% faster, line breaking about 40% faster and glyph decoding 20–25% faster. Uncached paragraphs now lay out 2–7× faster than DirectWrite.
- **Lighter client**: size work trimmed about 86 KB from MaiCord.exe and 70 KB from MaiCordAccount.dll. Graphics run on fewer threads, using about 3 MB less memory and up to 70% less CPU when idle.

- Notifications follow Discord's rules, and a server's unread pill counts only the channels you can see.
- Opening a server right after launch no longer jumps back to Home.
- Hover and selection fills, poll cards, the emoji and sticker pickers and the thread header now follow gradient themes.
- Poll answers select instantly, and narrow poll cards no longer leave empty space.
- The Friends tab no longer leaves a DM highlighted.
- Cancel and X close the avatar decoration and profile effect pickers.
- Slider stop marks are centred on the track.
- Loading spinners in Settings animate.
- The DM profile panel is drawn as an inset card.
- Profiles with long pronouns load.
- Invisible format characters no longer draw as boxes.
